review_candidates.title: Business Systems Analyst II – Contact Center Technology - Remote
review_candidates.description: Business Systems Analyst II - Contact Center Technology (Amazon Connect) We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst to join our Contact Center Technology team, which owns Amazon Connect for all ~30 of our call centers. The team migrated off Genesys to Amazon Connect roughly eight years ago and has run it ever since — it's a stable, established environment, but a high-demand one, since call centers are constantly evolving and need ongoing contact flow and routing changes (new queues, phone number/DID changes, reorg-driven updates, and more). In this individual contributor role, you will partner with business stakeholders to gather and document requirements, translate business needs into Amazon Connect configuration changes, and validate solutions through testing before they are turned over to the business. WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU: Business Systems Analyst II: $60,000 - $74,000 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match. Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details. Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment. This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings WHAT YOU'LL DO: Partner with business stakeholders across our call center operations to gather, analyze, and document requirements for Amazon Connect changes — such as queue additions, phone number/DID assignments, routing profile updates, quick connects, and contact flow adjustments driven by reorgs and other evolving business needs — and translate them into technical specifications developers can build from. Write user stories and requirements in JIRA, using a Confluence-based intake template to ensure key considerations (e.g., downstream reporting impacts) are captured during requirements conversations with the business. Partners with developers who implement the requested changes, then build and execute test cases to validate functionality — including hands-on IVR testing and use of the team's Cyara testing tool — before handoff to the business. Own the requirements, business relationship, and testing/communication for a growing portfolio of call centers (the team supports roughly 30 centers total). New team members typically ramp on a smaller set of less complex centers first, then take on larger, higher-volume centers as they build expertise. Support new contact center initiatives from inception — for example, if the team rolls out new Amazon Connect functionality — partnering with technical teams on the underlying infrastructure considerations. Contribute to expanding the team's use of automated testing within Cyara. Work alongside one other Business Systems Analyst on the team, plus supporting engineers, in a fully individual-contributor capacity. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and system requirements, and translating them into technical specifications specific enough for developers to act on (e.g., which routing profile, queue, or quick connect needs to change). Working familiarity with Amazon Connect concepts — routing profiles, queues, quick connects, contact flows — enough to ask the right questions and write requirements a developer can implement without back-and-forth. Experience supporting testing/QA activities, including test case development and validation; comfort with (or openness to) automated testing is a plus. Experience documenting in JIRA and Confluence, or comparable tools. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical stakeholders and clearly hand off requirements to developers at varying experience levels. Ability to work independently, build subject-matter expertise across multiple business lines/call centers, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Located in the United States, able to work remotely with a high-speed internet connection. PREFERRED: Hands-on Amazon Connect experience deep enough to personally work in contact flows and routing configuration, not just writing requirements for them — not expected of most candidates, but exactly the kind of technical depth that would set someone apart. Platform-level Amazon Connect knowledge, such as Lambda functions tied to contact flows. Prior experience within a call center or IVR systems environment. Experience with the Cyara testing tool (not required — training will be provided). Familiarity with NICE (screen/voice recording) is a modest plus, not a priority — the team is evaluating moving off NICE as early as next year, and one existing team member already covers this depth. We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply! Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!
